page_title: Wave.video — Easily Edit, Record, Multi-Stream & Host Videos | Wave.video

summary.name: Wave.video
summary.one_liner: Wave.video is an online all-in-one video platform combining a video editor, live streaming studio, thumbnail maker, video hosting, screen/video recorder, and stock library.
use_cases: Live stream to multiple channels at once
Host and embed videos on a website
Record videos or podcasts with guests
Add captions and subtitles to videos
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a browser-based video editor that can resize and trim videos, combine clips, change layouts, and add text animations, stickers, and transitions. It offers auto-generated editable captions and custom subtitles. A live streaming studio supports multistreaming to multiple channels simultaneously, guest invites, and pre-recorded video broadcasts. Other parts include a thumbnail maker with background removal, video hosting with shareable landing pages, embeddable players and analytics, an online recording tool that can share tabs or laptop videos, and a built-in library of stock videos, images, and audio.
notable: Combines editor, live streaming, thumbnail maker, hosting, recording, and stock library in one platform
Multistreaming to multiple channels simultaneously with no coding
Built-in stock library of videos, images, and audio
Listed under AI-related tools in eudk/awesome-ai-tools
caveats: Page says the free thumbnail maker is free, but does not state free-tier limits or paid plan prices
Stock assets are offered at a discounted price, implying payment for assets
